name: Yurikko Jogakuin ~Motto Ijimete! Onee-sama~
original_name: ユリっ娘女学院　～もっと虐めて！お姉さまっ～
source:
One day, Kei is saved by a girl when being molested by someone in a crowded train. Who saved Kei is a girl in a school uniform. Kei asks her name, but she doesn't answer, "Just call me sister. See you again." She leaves soon.... "Yes, sister. See you again!" Kei decides to take action to see her again....

[From [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20090727070633/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1012847]ErogeShop[/url]]
translation:
一天，圭在拥挤电车中遭人骚扰，被一名少女出手救下。救她的是一名身穿校服的少女。圭询问对方姓名，她却没有回答，只说道：“叫我姐姐就好。我们还会再见的。”随后便匆匆离去…“好的，姐姐。我们还会再见！”圭决定主动行动，再次与她相见…

[摘自[url=http://web.archive.org/web/20090727070633/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1012847]ErogeShop[/url]]
